root_cause_analysis: Python f-string syntax error in src/editorial_engine.py (line 58). Unescaped curly braces within an f-string prompt template were parsed as string format specifiers. Specifically, the JSON structure example inside the prompt containing '"...", "reality":"..."' caused the string parser to evaluate ':' as a format specifier for a str object, throwing a ValueError.
actionable_instructions: Escape all literal curly braces in the prompt string in src/editorial_engine.py by doubling them ('{{' and '}}').
Refactor prompt template definitions out of Python f-strings into standalone template files or raw multiline strings to prevent format string parsing errors.
Execute local test suite using 'pytest tests/test_editorial_engine.py' to ensure prompt compilation succeeds prior to pipeline restart.
